note: Single source of truth for the Epona entry of bench-v1 (DRAFT, not frozen). The adapter, the input builder and the spec generator read these values; change them only together with a new protocol version.

code.source_digest_rule: sha256 over the sorted *.py, *.yml, *.yaml files of the source tree (no .git, no __pycache__, no dotfiles): for each, the line '<path>\0<sha256 of file>\n' (the Orbis 2 pins' rule)

epona_nuplan+china.pkl.role: world model (STT 1214.5 M + VisDiT 1318.2 M + TrajDiT 59.0 M parameters, bfloat16), 'finetuned on in-house China driving data based on the base model'; the maintainer's recommendation for custom input (issue #17)

dcae_td_20000.pkl.role: temporal-aware DCAE f32c32 (323.7 M parameters, float32), finetuned on nuPlan clips

epona_nuplan.pkl.note: base model trained on nuPlan; the alternative checkpoint (open decision), not downloaded

epona_nuplan+nusc.pkl.note: finetuned on nuScenes (10 Hz config), not used

weights.sha256_source: computed locally after download; equal to the Hugging Face LFS oids of the pinned revision

released_defaults.script: scripts/test/test_demo.py (custom input, self-predicted trajectory); pose preparation as scripts/test/test_free.py (get_rel_pose over the condition frames' absolute poses)
released_defaults.sampler: rectified flow, Euler ODE, 100 steps for the VisDiT (shifted schedule get_schedule(100, 512)) and 100 steps for the TrajDiT (get_schedule(100, 15)); no guidance; initial noise torch.randn on the CPU generator, moved to the GPU
released_defaults.autocast: torch.bfloat16 around model.step_eval only (as the demo); DCAE encode/decode outside autocast
released_defaults.quantisation: (x.permute(1, 2, 0).numpy() * 255).astype('uint8') on z_to_image's [0, 1] output (truncation, as the demo)
released_defaults.seeding: random.seed, np.random.seed, torch.manual_seed, torch.cuda.manual_seed_all (the demo's start-of-run block), called with the sample's seed right before each sample
released_defaults.cudnn: deterministic=True, benchmark=False (the demo sets benchmark=True; changed for bit-reproducibility)

geometry.model_render: read_rgb (cv2.imread + BGR2RGB), crop the band rows, cv2.resize(crop, (1024, 512), INTER_AREA): the 16:9 band squashed to 2:1, as Epona's loaders squash nuPlan's 16:9 CAM_F0 frames (PIL BICUBIC resize to 1024x512, no crop)
geometry.model_to_canvas: Epona frame rows covering source rows [797, min(b, 1669)) (rows [(797 - a) * 512 / 872, 512)), cv2.resize INTER_AREA to canvas rows [0, (min(b, 1669) - 797) * 288 / 872) at width 512; uncovered canvas rows black. With the default band this is cv2.resize(frame, (512, 288), INTER_AREA): it undoes the squash and leaves the canvas geometry (K_canvas) unchanged
geometry.model_band_rule: a 16:9 full-width band of 872 source rows [a, a + 872), a <= 797, with (797 - a) * 512 / 872 an integer, squashed to 1024x512. bench-v1 uses [579, 1451) (owner decision D2, 2026-11-03): the principal point (source row ~1021) at mid-height, as in nuPlan front frames; [797, 1669), the measurement band itself, was the first draft and re-framed moving scenes on DEV

horizon_centred (bench-v1).note: canvas rows [216, 288) (source rows 1451-1669, flat ground nearer than about 7 m) are not covered and are written black

timing.ticks: k = -20, -18, ..., 60 (5 Hz grid of the bench's 10 Hz ticks t0 + k x 0.1 s; each tick is the nearest 20 Hz camera frame, as in window.json)

output.layout: frames 0-10 (k = -20..0 step 2): the per-frame DCAE round trip of the 11 history frames (identical to the real reference's frames 0-10); frames 11-40 (k = 2..60 step 2): the 30 generated frames
output.encoder: ffmpeg libx264rgb -crf 0 -preset medium, rgb24, 5 fps, video_track_timescale 10240; decoded frames checked equal
output.native: optional native.mp4: the same 41 frames at 1024x512 before the canvas resize (--save-native)

environment.lock_rule: uv pip compile lock-pyproject.toml --python-version 3.10 --python-platform x86_64-manylinux_2_28 --exclude-newer 2025-07-23T00:00:00Z --generate-hashes (the day after the pinned commit)

decisions.D2_band: horizon-centred band, source rows [579, 1451) -> 1024x512 model frame -> canvas rows [0, 216) of the 512x288 canvas; canvas rows [216, 288) black; disclosed deviation, the near-road loss shows up in scorability
decisions.D4_layout: TEST and DEV-full on cluster H200 with batch 16, fixed layout one window per batch (k 0..15); local DEV runs, if any, batch 2-4, recorded as a different layout; never mix layouts within one run
decisions.D5_instrument: 5 Hz canvas-instrument extension built by the shared instrument agent (not in this kit)
decisions.D6_trajectory: Epona's own predicted ego trajectory (pred_traj.npy) reported as an exploratory result
decisions.storage: no native-resolution frames for TEST; lossless writer with x264 preset ultrafast
